extracted.name: Italian Baked Meatballs
extracted.description: These beefy baked meatballs are super tender and tasty thanks to the addition of Italian-seasoned bread crumbs, garlic, parsley, and Romano cheese.
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients and preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Mix bread crumbs, Romano cheese, parsley, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder together in a large bowl; stir in water and eggs.
Add ground beef and mix until well combined.
Form mixture into balls and place on a nonstick baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven cooked through and evenly browned, about 30 minutes.
